lines.en: Far across town, in a room you somehow haven’t seen yet despite this being the fourth chapter of the game...
: AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHH!
: Your hair! Your beautiful hair! It’s gone! Who did this?! Do you have cancer?! Are you dying?! Because I don’t want to watch you die again, Ami! I love you! I’ll save you!
: I love you too, Ayane. But I would love you more if you would stop sexually harassing me this early in the morning. Thank you for understanding.
: Also, when did you watch me die? Because I am very much alive despite having not felt that way at all in the several months before today.
: Long story. Doesn’t matter. Is this what you look like now? Are you going through changes? Or did someone do this to you?
: Sana’s mom did it.
: Sara?! Why?! She’s normally so pretty and nice! I’ve seen her a zillion times and she’s never cut off my hair! Why would she do that to you?!
: She kind of had to. And I actually...kind of like it like this.
: And I save so much money on shampoo. Which you probably won’t understand since you’re rich. But, like, it’s seriously a lot.
: What about Sensei, though? He loved your long hair. That was the whole reason you kept growing it out, wasn’t it?
: Yes. But I now know that Sensei will love me regardless of how I look.
: Especially since he has already experienced how magical and wonderful having sex with me is and I don’t need to lure him in anymore.
: I just wish that he’d love me a little more physically. But, oh well. His room’s not going anywhere and I can still sneak in to get my fill of him whenever he isn’t home.
: That was actually shaping up to be a really cute line until you went and ruined it.

: Yeah, well...ruining things is kind of my specialty. Which is why I want to apologize for any weird stuff I may have said to you while Sensei was in a coma. But I don’t remember much of it, to be honest.
: It’s okay, Ami...I get that you and Sensei have a...complicated relationship. I just hope you don’t shut me out if something like this ever happens again.
: Just hit me next time. That’s what you did on the beach and that worked pretty well, didn’t it?
: Maybe a little. But you were still creepy as heck and clearly not as invested in our friendship as I was.
: Well, it’s hard to be invested in any friendship when the only person I ever think about is my dad.
: I’m talking about Sensei.
: I figured, but you accidentally called him “Dad” so-
: That wasn’t an accident. That’s just what I call him now.
: Mutually, of course! We had a serious talk about how we really see one another and...that’s kind of just where we landed.
: I’m really happy for you, Ami.
: Thanks, Ayane.
: I just hope you know that this means I’m going to call him Dad too from now on since he’s been watching over me pretty much just as long as you.
: Do it. We can be sisters.
: Wait, for real? I didn’t think you’d agree to that so easily.
: I’m a changed girl, Ayane. Even if I don’t look like one anymore.
: What does this mean for Maya then? Are we converting the entire Sensei Love Squad into the Sensei Love Sisterhood? Are we just a big, incestuous family now?
: Nah. Maya can stay Maya, but you can be my sister. Just don’t tell her I said that. I don’t want her getting jealous.
: Hey, where is she anyway? I thought she was coming over today too?
: Maya? I’ve got no idea.
: Pants off now, asshole! We’ve got approximately one hour before Ayane starts asking me where I am and I am not letting it go to waste!
: Why are you here?...
: Because men aren’t the only ones with needs!
: Yeah, but how did you even get in?

: I know where you keep the spare key, obviously. And I even made sure to show up when Ami isn’t home so we can be as loud as we want and not risk getting caught. Plus, I brought your favorite costume.
: Are you seriously going to look at me in all of my adorable miko glory and refuse sex with me? Is this what we’ve become?
: We haven’t become anything. We aren’t anything. I don’t know you and I don’t want you here.
: Okay. Well, I know you.
: And I’m kind of like, in love with you or whatever,
: Come on, Sensei...I said the thing. You know how hard that is for me.
: Don’t I deserve, like...a reward or something?
: Listen, I...
: This is getting kind of...weird.
: Like, I still don’t even know if I did something or...if there’s something I can do...but, like...
: What if I get on top this time?
: Thanks, Geoffrey! You’re the best!
: And good luck in Antarctica! I’m sure your precious family heirlooms will turn up in no time at all!
: It’s crazy how he got permission to leave the city, isn’t it?
: Yeah, I wish we could go with him. Never underestimate Geoffrey’s connections, I guess.
: I just hope the Black Panthers don’t get involved this time. He has enough on his plate without them.
: If anyone can handle an extra plate, it’s Geoffrey.
: So! You put any thought into when you’ll be coming back to school yet? Or are you still trying to lie low for the indefinite future?
: Ugh...I don’t know. Sensei says I-
: Dad.
: Dad says it’s fine for me to spend as much time as I need at home, but I feel really bad about how much...attention I’ve been getting, you know?
: No, actually. That sounds like the exact opposite of what the Ami I know would say.
: Okay, like...yeah. I love it. But I don’t want to feel like a burden anymore, Ayane. And I also don’t want to have to deal with the rest of the girls in class.
: It was weird enough just going back to the maid cafe. And Chika clearly hates me, so...that’s one shit-list I don’t want to be on.
: Well, I’m not really Chika’s biggest fan either. So if it comes down to picking sides, you’ll have me.
: What happened with you and Chika?
: Way more than I’d like to admit. But that’s not a thing I really want to talk about with you.
: I’m confused.
: Chika seems to have a problem with anyone that spends time with Sensei, so I’m sure she doesn’t like me either.
: You really think so?
: Ami, don’t worry about what the other girls think. I think most people understand that none of that came from the heart.
: I mean...it kind of did, though.
: Like, maybe not the violent parts of it, but I still don’t want anybody else getting close to my dad. Nor do I want them pretending that they’re not already doing that behind my back.
: You’re fine, though. You can keep having sex with him if you want.
: Ami!
: What? It’s not like I didn’t already know about you two. Plus, if he’s going to sleep with anyone not named Ami Arakawa, I’d want it to be you because you actually love him.
: I...yeah. But that’s still a weird thing to say to my face.
: I’ve said much weirder stuff to your face, Ayane. Like this — why don’t I watch you two sometime? Just to make sure you’re doing it right.
: Ami! Stop it!
: I bought a few of Niki’s light sticks online a while back. Maybe I could wave them around and cheer you guys on if you won’t let me in on the action?
: Why would you even want in on the action? We don’t see each other that way.
: Yeah, but we see Dad that way. Right, sis?
: I feel so uncomfortable right now.
: I’d take anything at this point, to be honest. And if a threesome is required for me to fuck my father, a threesome I shall have.
: I feel so uncomfortable right now.
: I’m not trying to make you uncomfortable, Ayane. I really don’t mind the two of you being more than just...what you’ve been the rest of my life.
: You’re just saying that. And you’re being creepy again.
: Are you gonna hit me?
: I feel like I should just to snap you out of it.
: Okay, just not too hard. I don’t want Sensei seeing any black eyes and getting worried.
: How long have you known?
: A while, I guess. But I had a hard time accepting it until I looked through his phone and understood the gravity of everything.
: Yeah, so I’m pretty fucking miserable now. That’s fun.
: Ami...
: It is what it is, you know? He’s the ideal man.
: Caring...handsome...mysterious...handsome. Thinking everyone else would just ignore that for my sake is delusional when no one even likes me. Oh, and did I mention how handsome he is?
: Plenty of people like you, Ami.
: Not enough to not fuck my dad, I guess. Like, just look at you. You like me more than anybody and you’d still choose him over me. And you’d be right.
: Ami, I don’t want to choose between you two.
: Threesome it is, then.
: I don’t want to have a threesome either!
: Well, now my feelings are just hurt.
: Ami...are you really okay with Sensei-
: Dad.
: Are you really okay with...Dad and me being together?
: I’m confused. Are you, like...asking for my blessing? Because you sure haven’t needed it so far.
: Maybe I am. I’m not really sure. But with you, it’s...
: I know you’re smarter than you let on. And I don’t want this to be the sort of friendship where you’re only pretending to like me because you’re getting something out of it.
: With all due respect, Ayane...what exactly do I get from you? There’s no benefit to be gained from your friendship apart from just...being your friend. But that’s all I want, really.
: Maya would never admit she’s sleeping with Sensei to my face. I even gave her the chance to the other day and she completely dropped the ball. At least you’re open with your love.
: And that’s good. Because that’s the type of love Dad needs. He needs someone with feelings so powerful that they wouldn’t dare be kept secret in the name of preserving some other relationship.
: I can do that. You can do that. Niki and Noriko can probably do that. But Maya? She’d never admit it to anyone. Hell, I’d be surprised if she’s even admitted how she feels to herself.
: Sorry. I know this isn’t the kind of conversation you had in mind when you invited me over today. I just felt weird hiding stuff from you.
: I love you.
: I’d appreciate it if you’d make him wear a condom, though. I don’t want to babysit a child my dad made without me.
: So, uhh...video games.
: Sorry again. I’m not really good at “being open.”
: You’re fine, I just...
: Don’t trust me...right?
: I don’t blame you, Ayane. I wouldn’t trust me either. But...
: I hope you can trust me more than the person ditching us right now to do exactly what we both wish we were doing.
